column2: (5) A request  under subsection (3) can be validly made,
where the electronic presentment has failed or did
not enable the banker on whom the cheque is drawn
to  conclude  with  adequate  certainty  that  in
honouring  the  cheque  he  is  complying  with  the
instructions of his customer who is stated as being
the drawer of the cheque ; and
where the banker on whom the cheque is drawn has
reasonable grounds to believe that there is a greater
likelihood that he could arrive at such conclusion
on the basis of the presentment of the cheque itself,
